Smart Pet Detection: Only captures when a dog or cat is in frame.
Custom Shutter Sounds: Dog barks or secret Cat meows.
Branded Watermarking: High-quality DogCam branding on every save.
Professional Bounding Boxes: Real-time ML tracking with toggle support.
Tap-to-Focus: Metering and forced re-detection on tap.
Intelligent UI: Controls rotate with your phone\'s orientation.
Pro Storage: Images saved to dedicated DogCam gallery folder.
Full Metadata: Saves all orientation and EXIF data.
Advanced Zoom: Smooth zoom with haptic feedback at 1.0x.
Dual Camera Support: Full front and rear camera integration.
Volume Shutter: Use volume buttons as physical triggers.
Smart Interlock: Shutter feedback and prevention for better shots.
